listing.name: Hazard Mining Incorporated
listing.summary: Many cycles ago, a daring space miner called Haseo 'Hazard' Fuyutsuki set out into the Outer Rim to make his fortune with nothing by a Shepherd, some loose change and a dream. Today, the Company he founded holds an iron grip beyond the Core Worlds, always seeking more profit.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a new faction with unique junker ships, techmined hulls, and hidden systems.

description: Many cycles ago, a daring space miner called Haseo 'Hazard' Fuyutsuki set out into the Outer Rim to make his fortune with nothing by a Shepherd, some loose change and a dream. Today, the Company he founded holds an iron grip beyond the Core Worlds, always seeking more profit. Made up of adventurers, freebooters and mercenaries, Hazard Mining Incorporated is well known as a company where anyone can make their fortune. It is also well known for being unethical in the acquisition of goods, luxuries and technology from the Outer Rim colonies. The Luddic Church often demands the destruction of this 'Soulless Machine', and other established factions are rendered nervous by the accusations of briganditry, banditry, protection racketeering, and possibly even genocide. But while the Company continues to churn out absurdedly high profits and an endless supply of raw goods, the major factions remain placated...for now...

discordPostHtml:
-Locomotive (LP) modules fixed.
-Mining Hybridization Amplifier now works (for both ships and launched fighters), but only for Mining Lasers, Chimoboku Mining Lasers and Mining Laser Arrays.
-Chimoboku Mining Lasers, Mining Laser Arrays and Suzuki-Clapteryon Thermal Projector now change colours based on hull style.
-Minor spell checking.

[[0.4.0d quickfix]]
-Removed Suzuki-Clapteryon Thermal Projector alt skins, as they were doing weird things to tpcs

[[0.4.0e bugfix]]
-Fixed multiple spawning procgen systems for real this time (Many thanks to Tranquility and Skye Neon!)
Savegame Compatible with previous mod version, but fixes will only occur with new game.

Download: https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/87mpigntc8tfwc6ey9t2s/HMI_0_4_0e.zip?rlkey=bzjviqccosoazp7pxjmq5xt1p&st=e0ti7nn7&dl=1
aiDescription: Introduces a faction known for unethical practices and high profits, featuring cheap but durable junker ships and powerful but flawed techmined hulls. The mod includes hidden systems, mini-boss factions, and unique commodities, requiring a new game to start.
saveCompatibilityText: THIS MOD REQUIRES A NEW GAME TO USE; DO NOT USE WITH PRE-EXISTING SAVE.
